For who is there of those who are alive who has not sinned, and who of the children of men hasn’t transgressed your covenant?","chapter":7,"verse":46},{"text":"Now I see that the world to come will bring delight to few, but torments to many.","chapter":7,"verse":47},{"text":"For an evil heart has grown up in us, which has led us astray from these commandments and has brought us into corruption and into the ways of death. Defer to her, and she will declare it to you.","chapter":7,"verse":54},{"text":"Say to her, ‘You produce gold, silver, and brass, and also iron, lead, and clay;","chapter":7,"verse":55},{"text":"but silver is more abundant than gold, and brass than silver, and iron than brass, and lead than iron, and clay than lead.’","chapter":7,"verse":56},{"text":"Judge therefore which things are precious and to be desired, what is abundant or what is rare?”","chapter":7,"verse":57},{"text":"I said, “O sovereign Lord, that which is plentiful is of less worth, for that which is more rare is more precious.”","chapter":7,"verse":58},{"text":"He answered me, “Weigh within yourself the things that you have thought, for he who has what is hard to get rejoices over him who has what is plentiful.","chapter":7,"verse":59},{"text":"So also is the judgment which I have promised; for I will rejoice over the few that will be saved, because these are those who have made my glory to prevail now, and through them, my name is now honored.","chapter":7,"verse":60}],"chapter":7,"book_code":"2ES"}
